blocks.title: Multi-cloud
blocks.text: A multi-cloud approach uses cloud services from several different providers, avoiding dependence on one provider and improving reliability and performance.

A company might use Google Cloud Platform for data analytics, Microsoft Azure for enterprise applications and Amazon Web Services for backup and disaster recovery, so if one provider has problems the others keep working.

blocks.prompt: How is multi-cloud different from hybrid cloud?
blocks.explanation: Hybrid mixes public and private clouds; multi-cloud uses several providers' clouds (often all public) to avoid relying on one.

items: Multi-cloud: several providers for resilience (GCP, Azure, AWS).
